details.name: CLUTCHED!
details.short_description: *Clutched!* is a 2D side-scrolling steampunk adventure game! Experience the exhilarating fun of physics-based swinging, climbing, and impacts! It's a small, exquisitely crafted indie game, essentially made by one person.
details.about_the_game:
*Clutched!* is a 2D side-scrolling steampunk adventure game.

The main storyline lasts approximately 2-3 hours, with a wealth of side quests for players to challenge and explore.

This is a small, exquisitely crafted indie game, essentially created by a single developer who handled planning, programming, and art.

The protagonist is a small, incomplete robot with only a head and arms, connected by a single steel cable, yet capable of launching incredibly powerful rocket punches!

Use these to grab various interesting and diverse items, experiencing a constant stream of novel challenges, smashing enemies along the way, solving ingenious puzzles, and exploring the unknown truths of this world.

This is a steampunk world ruled by machines, where humanity remains a rare species.

Even the player-controlled protagonist is just a small, incomplete robot, unaware of his own identity. What does his complete form look like? What did he do in the past? These questions draw the player and protagonist forward on their journey.

The game's theme is: sometimes imperfection is more beautiful than wholeness.

Although the protagonist has a physical disability, they can unexpectedly perform many actions with smooth and fluid gameplay, offering a satisfying experience.

The game places great emphasis on gameplay, focusing on the enjoyment of level progression.

The character gradually grows stronger during exploration, and players will gradually become familiar with the properties of various objects to grasp, eventually mastering their use to overcome various challenges.

The character's identity will be gradually revealed as the game progresses, and a magnificent steampunk world will gradually unfold before the player's eyes.

There are also unique NPCs and intriguing stories waiting for players to discover.

details.name: 缆绳火箭拳
details.short_description: 《缆绳火箭拳》是一款 2D 横版蒸汽朋克冒险游戏！ 可以体验到物理摆荡、攀爬、冲击的爽快乐趣~ 基本上由一人制作的精致小巧的独立游戏。 主角是一个残缺的小机器人靠缆绳火箭拳闯关解谜，探寻自我真相。 关卡丰富有趣，注重游戏性。 玩家能抓取到各种各样不同特性的物体，逐渐熟练掌握、娴熟应用，以应对各种各样的挑战。
details.about_the_game:
《缆绳火箭拳》是一款2D横版蒸汽朋克冒险游戏。

游戏主线的时长约2~3小时，还有丰富的支线内容供玩家挑战游玩和探索。

这是一款精致小巧的独立游戏，基本上由一位制作者完成，一个人承担了策划、程序、美术等的工作。

主角是一个只剩头和手臂的残缺小机器人，仅由一条钢缆连接，却可以发射威力惊人的火箭拳！

凭此抓取各种有趣多样的物品，有着层出不穷的新奇体验，击碎沿途的敌人、破解创意的谜题，探索这个世界未知的真相。

这是一个由机械统治的蒸汽朋克的世界，人类依然成为珍稀物种。

就连玩家扮演的主角也只是一个残缺不全的小机器人，他对自己的身份一无所知，他完整的形态究竟是什么样子？过去又做过什么？这些都牵引着玩家和主角继续向前路探索。

游戏的主题是：有时，不完美比完美更美~

虽然主角身体残缺，但是却能意外做出很多意想不到的行动，过程还丝滑流畅，富有爽快的游戏性。

游戏非常注重gameplay，也就是游戏性的部分，注重关卡体验的乐趣。

角色会在探索的过程中逐渐成长，玩家也会在这个过程中逐步熟悉各种抓取物的特性，最终熟练应用，以应对各种挑战。

角色的身份也会在前进的道路上层层解密，瑰丽的蒸汽朋克世界也会逐步呈现在玩家眼前。

还有富有个性的NPC、耐人寻味的故事，等待玩家一一去发现。

details.name: Tia:weird hunter
details.short_description: Welcome to Tia: Weird Hunter, a hand-drawn 2D action RPG. Unleash fast, fluid combos, and take on fierce boss battles that will test your reflexes and skills. Play as the mysterious Scythe Maiden as you explore the vivid, fantastical city known as the Faceless City.
details.about_the_game:
A Hand-Painted Journey Into the Unknown

Begin your adventure in a finely crafted hand-drawn world. Explore the “Faceless City” as the Scythe Maiden, uncover the truth behind the mutiny of the Tomorrow’s Flower Legion, and fight to save the Weirdkin.

 

The Faceless City

This strange metropolis is shrouded in black mist year-round. Its districts are isolated, with only the societal elite allowed to travel between them via “trains.” Ordinary residents are confined to fragmented zones, unable to grasp the city's full structure. As a result, the people have come to call it the Faceless City.

Each region, shaped by the ever-present mist, has developed its own distinct geography, culture, and atmosphere. Your journey through these divided zones will be one of mystery, beauty, and danger.

 

Fast and Fluid Combat

Wield a scythe that symbolizes death and engage in thrilling real-time combat. Combine a wide variety of attack chains and freely mix 15 unique skill types to unleash satisfying, high-impact combos.

Exquisite Hand-Drawn Visuals

Immerse yourself in a stunning 2D world brought to life through frame-by-frame and grid-by-grid hand-drawn animation. From dynamic combat sequences to narrative-driven comic panels, every frame is crafted with care and artistry.

 

Challenging Boss Fights

Face off against dozens of powerful bosses, each boasting visually striking attacks and multi-phase mechanics. Survive, adapt, and overcome as you encounter one deadly foe after another.

Deep Character Growth

Shape your character through a robust progression system featuring a talent tree, skill upgrades, equipment, and a pet system. Scavenge for materials, uncover hidden treasures, and grow stronger as you advance through the city’s layered world.

details.name: 猎异者
details.short_description: 《猎异者》是一款手绘风格的 2D 横板动作角色扮演游戏。有着节奏明快的战斗、庞大的线性关卡和丰富多样的角色成长。玩家将扮演冒险者，探索神秘的“无貌之都”。 ﻿ ﻿
details.about_the_game:
【关注我们】

加入QQ群：676746738

在精致的手绘风格的架空世界中开始冒险。您将操控神秘的镰刀少女，探索这座奇幻多彩的神秘都市——“无貌之都”，寻找明日之花变革的真相，拯救异族。

﻿

无貌之都：

一座常年被黑雾笼罩的都市，内部的各个区域被分割，只有社会的精英阶层可以通过“列车”来往各个区域。普通居民无法了解到整个城都市的全貌。因此，大众们将自己生活的这个都市命名为“无貌之都。”

由于黑雾，无貌之都的每个区域都有着属于自己的地貌、人情风格。

【爽快而刺激的连段战斗】

  • 挥舞象征死亡的镰刀进行战斗。利用丰富的攻击派生动作并自由组合15种风格迥异的技能打出爽快的连段。

﻿

【精致的手绘画风】

  • 游戏中有许多精致的手绘背景、动画和漫画。通过大量的逐帧、逐格绘制来展现这款游戏的视觉特色。

﻿【精彩的boss战斗】

  • 数十场精彩的Boss战斗。直面不同阶段怪物的华丽的技能

﻿【丰富的成长系统】

天赋树、技能升级、装备系统、宠物系统。在冒险过程中收集材料、搜寻宝物不断提升玩家的能力

﻿

details.name: Dynasty Blade
details.short_description: This is a Chinese Kungfu stylish 3D action Game, You can perform unlimited sword martial art combo! This stroy happens in a famous chaos dynasty period in China. Use your sword to finish the enemies and boss to save the world, and become the greatest warrior!
details.about_the_game:
"Dynasty Blade", a 3D Chinese style sword martial arts action game that is easy to play! You will act as a warrior in the Chaos Dynasty.

About game mechanics

You can perform unlimited combo with the burst of energy! How to use the Ki can perform different battle.

Special feature: Ki system

Perfect parry and attack give you Ki, so you can be free to use them to battle.

Interesting Story

The story and character are Chinese style, they battle with Chinese martial arts in this world. Recreates the path to becoming a legendary warrior  in this chaotic dynasty!

details.name: 天剑
details.short_description: 中国风3D武侠动作游戏，上手简单，战斗爽快，连段华丽！您将扮演一名乱世剑客，走上成为武林王者的觉醒之路！
details.about_the_game:
《天剑》，一款上手简单，连段爽快的国风3D武侠动作游戏！您将扮演一名剑客，踏上乱世中的江湖进行冒险。

核心游戏机制：连段和取消

游戏核心战斗方式，配合内力的运用进行更加自由的爽快的连招！除了曝气还有必杀技等内力使用技巧。

内力系统

完美格挡，连段攻击都能提高内力。消耗内力更可释放终极剑招扭转战局。

丰富剧情

中国风格的武侠江湖，丰富的剧情文本，重现乱世王者之路！

details.name: Rogue Link Loop
details.short_description: Link matching tiles via paths with up to two turns. Clear tiles to cast spells, build structures, and summon allies. Diverse spells and relics ensure fresh runs. Counter unique elite disruptors.
details.about_the_game:
This is a strategy game that blends match-connect elimination with tower defense roguelike. Enemies march along a looping path, and you must match tiles to cast spells, construct buildings, and summon allies, forging a unique battle system for each run.

Core Features:

  • Eliminate to Fight: Focus on matching. Click two identical tiles—if they can be connected by a straight line with at most two turns—to gain energy and instantly cast a corresponding spell.

  • Deep Build Variety: A vast array of relics, spells, and characters ensures every run feels different. Mix projectile, summoning, and building spells to craft your elemental build.

  • Wave-Based Challenges with Unique Elites: Ink blots blind, sandstorms scramble, ice freezes—each elite disrupts your matching in its own way.

  • Difficulty for All: Whether casual or hardcore, the trinity of matching, building, and battling delivers the joy of fresh strategies every run.

details.name: 肉鸽连连圈
details.short_description: 这是一款融合连连看与塔防Roguelike的游戏。通过双拐点连线消除来释放法术、建造建筑、召唤友军。丰富的法术与遗物构筑让每局体验都不同，还需应对独特精英干扰。
details.about_the_game:
这是一款融合连连看消除与塔防Roguelike的策略游戏。敌人沿环形道路进攻，你需要通过连连看消除来释放法术、建造建筑、召唤友军，构筑每局独一无二的战斗体系。

核心特色：

  • 消除即战斗：专注消除，点击两个相同图案，如果它们在最多两个拐点内直线相连，即可获得能量，瞬间释放对应法术。

  • 丰富的构筑维度：数量众多的遗物、法术和角色，每局都带来不同的体验。投射物，召唤，建筑等多种法术组合，打造你的元素构筑。

  • 多波次挑战，独特精英：墨汁遮挡视野、沙尘暴模糊、冰块冻结等干扰，每个精英都以独特方式干扰你的操作。

  • 难度自选，休闲与挑战并存，消除、构筑、战斗，三位一体。每局带来不同策略的快乐。

details.name: Songs of Wasteland
details.short_description: Songs of Wasteland is a horror third-person shooter. You play as a lone hero Emma who wanders the wasteland which has no sign of civilization. Only terrifying monsters lurk in the shadows and underground. Shoot, explore, and survive, the future of humanity is in your hands.
details.about_the_game:
Songs of Wasteland is a horror third-person shooter. You play as a lone hero Emma who wanders the wasteland which has no sign of civilization. Only terrifying monsters lurk in the shadows and underground. Shoot, explore, and survive, the future of humanity is in your hands.

A Terrifying World

It is an empty world on the surface, where have all the humans gone? However something terrifying lurks in the shadows and underground：twisted monsters look like humans, or, used to be humans.

The Lone Adventurer Emma

Emma is not a trained fighter, but she needs to learn how to protect herself when she walks out of that shelter, and becomes a fighter along the journey. Can Emma discover why the world becomes like this and eventually find the way to save the world? It is all up to you.

Abilities and Weapons Upgrades

During the journey, Emma will grow and will become more capable. New weapons, gears and upgrades will be discovered along the way.

Nostalgia for the Old World When the Humans Flourish

Sometimes old artifacts or pieces of old technology may be discovered on the wasteland. Emma can learn how the humans live in the old times.

Exploration and Collectables

Emma can collect decorative items and outfits by exploring the game world, and adventure in style.

Multiple Endings

The game features multiple endings based on player choice when progressing through the campaign.

details.name: 她与荒芜之歌
details.short_description: 她与荒芜之歌是一个第三人称射击恐怖游戏。你扮演一个孤独的英雄Emma在失去人类文明的荒芜世界中漂泊。这片土地只剩下恐怖的怪物藏匿于阴影和地底之下。射击，探索，活下去，人类的未来在你的手中。
details.about_the_game:
她与荒芜之歌是一个第三人称射击恐怖游戏。你扮演一个孤独的英雄Emma在失去人类文明的荒芜世界中漂泊。这片土地只剩下恐怖的怪物藏匿于阴影和地底之下。射击，探索，活下去，人类的未来在你的手中。

一个充满危险的世界

从表面上看这是一个空无一人的世界，曾经繁华的人类社会都去哪儿了？但是在阴暗处或是地底，有某种可怕的东西在游荡，某种像是人一样的扭曲怪物，或者说曾经是人的怪物。

孤独的冒险者Emma

Emma并不是一个受过训练的战士，但是当踏出避难所的那一刻，她就必须学习如何战斗来保护自己，并在旅途中逐渐成长为一名战士。Emma能发现世界崩塌的原因并最终找到重塑世界的方法吗？这些全都取决与你。

能力，装备，及武器强化

在旅途中，Emma将不断成长，不断变强。新的武器及新的武器强化也将会在冒险中获得。

对旧世界中人类繁盛时期的怀旧

有时候Emma将在冒险中找到一些过去世界的遗物，或是古老的科技，从而能够窥见过去人类美好生活的碎片。

探索与收集物

如果对环境仔细探索，Emma能够收集到一些装饰品和服装，然后用不同的打扮继续旅途吧。

多结局

取决于玩家在特定时刻的选择，游戏将会有多个结局。
